config.design: All13 groups x4 recipients x2 fixed directions. At first downstream MLP, native recipient output +amp*analytic response; attention and skip remain natural. Own,zero-response,and all3 other-baseline or other-input responses. Cross only one factor at a time. Signs +/-0.1.
config.references: KL(own analytic-response intervention || candidate) across full vocabulary, zero-response control. Own-vs-natural replay measured separately. Zero response retains original upstream intervention and other paths.
config.selection: No refits or selected reference; all three alternative natural references included.
config.limitation: Local linear response replacements and hybrid interventions; not baseline activation swaps or whole-model nonlinear operator recovery.
